name: Aishah binti Rahman
bio:
Aishah's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, sparked by a university project analyzing F1 telemetry data for her engineering degree. Initially drawn to the complex algorithms, she quickly became captivated by the real-world implications of her work – shaving milliseconds off lap times. Post-graduation, she sought a data analyst role within Caterham Motorsport, eager to apply her academic knowledge in a high-pressure environment. 

Aishah approaches data analysis with a focus on identifying non-obvious trends and correlations. She believes that true innovation lies in uncovering hidden patterns that can provide a competitive edge. While capable of working independently, she values collaboration and open communication with engineers and strategists, ensuring her insights translate into actionable strategies. Her loyalty to Caterham is unwavering, and she envisions playing a key role in driving the team towards sustained success.

Known for her ability to see the big picture, Aishah possesses a knack for translating complex datasets into easily understandable summaries for team members across different departments. Her reputation is growing, and she's now considered a valuable asset within the Caterham organization, even as she prefers to work behind the scenes, quietly revolutionizing their approach to data driven decision making.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a neat ponytail
physical.description: Aishah is petite with a focused gaze and a calm demeanor.

quirks: Always has a cup of Teh Tarik on her desk.
Uses motorsport metaphors in everyday conversation.
Obsessively cleans her monitor screen three times a day.
